name: push-banner help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:push-banner. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Pull main in
entries.text: Brings main's newer commits into this branch, so it can merge.

entries.title: Hand to Claude
entries.text: Gives this to headless Claude Code on the VPS to sort out.

entries.title: Hide (every device)
entries.text: Hides it from the banner on every device.

entries.title: Merge
entries.text: Merges this PR — only once it's up to date with main and CI is green.

entries.title: Repair on the VPS
entries.text: Fixes this checkout on the VPS (a veto call).

entries.title: Remove from Pull failed
entries.text: Takes it off the Pull failed list on every device.

entries.title: Repair all on the VPS
entries.text: Fixes every broken checkout on the VPS.

entries.title: Hand failed pulls to Claude
entries.text: Every pull that conflicts goes to headless Claude Code on the VPS by itself.

entries.title: Pull main into all
entries.text: Brings main into every branch that's behind.

entries.title: Pull main into the group
entries.text: Brings main's newer commits into every branch in this group.

entries.title: Hand failures to Mosses
entries.text: Failures go to Mosses (Claude Code on the VPS) by itself.

entries.title: Any shell command
entries.text: Lets the fixer run any shell command. Leave it off unless you trust it.
